Since Alphabet announced the higher capex forecast, the Philly Semiconductor Index has fallen for five consecutive trading days. With Meta and Microsoft now showing relatively modest capex strategies, the index may end this decline with a strong rebound.
For Nvidia, the price bounce may not be solely tied to the earnings or AI spending of large tech companies.

Nvidia’s stock now looks quite cheap. According to Dow Jones market data, Nvidia’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio is about 17.5×, the lowest level since April 1, 2015. The upward move in Nvidia’s share price appears to be only a matter of time.

items.title: 上車在即！阿里千問已在特斯拉車機內測
items.title_en: Boarding Soon! Alibaba's Qianwen Already in Tesla In‑Car System Testing
paras: 多位知情人士透露，阿里千問已進入特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 中國車機的深度測試階段，上車在即。
千問已經在特斯拉真實車機環境下完成大量上車測試工作，「能聽能答、能控車、能導航、能辦事，都已經在計畫內」。
據《科創板日報》31 日（周五）報導，未來千問在特斯拉車機上能提供的能力，可能遠超單一「語音助手」的定義。
2026 北京車展上，中國一線車廠已經宣布陸續接入千問，從揭露的技術路線來看，千問上車至少具備三層能力：
一是複雜語義與多任務路徑規劃；
二是打通「點單—履約—支付」的辦事閉環；
三是端雲協同架構下，覆蓋內容、生活、交易全場景。
對於千問何時正式上車，截至發稿，阿里雲與特斯拉中國均未正式回應。
paras_en: Multiple insiders say Alibaba's Qianwen has entered the deep testing phase on Tesla (TSLA-US) Chinese in‑car systems, with deployment imminent.

Qianwen has already completed extensive on‑vehicle testing in real Tesla infotainment environments, and "listening and answering, vehicle control, navigation, and task handling are all within the plan."
According to the Science and Innovation Board Daily on the 31st (Friday), the capabilities Qianwen may offer on Tesla's in‑car system could far exceed the definition of a single "voice assistant."

At the 2026 Beijing Auto Show, leading Chinese automakers announced they would gradually integrate Qianwen. Based on the disclosed technical roadmap, Qianwen's on‑vehicle deployment includes at least three layers of capability: (1) complex semantics and multi‑task path planning; (2) a closed loop for ordering, fulfillment, and payment; and (3) under a edge‑cloud collaborative architecture, coverage of content, lifestyle, and transaction scenarios across the board.
As for when Qianwen will officially be on board, as of this publication, neither Alibaba Cloud nor Tesla China has responded formally.

items.title: 伊朗戰火擴至紅海！沙國牽頭43國緊急磋商 組海上防禦聯盟
items.title_en: Iran's War Expands to the Red Sea! Saudi Arabia Leads 43 Nations in Urgent Talks to Form a Maritime Defense Alliance
paras: 沙烏地阿拉伯周四（30 日）公布一項組建多國海上防禦聯盟的計畫，旨在保護紅海國際航運和能源供應路線。
連接紅海南部、亞丁灣和印度洋的曼德海峽，是全球貿易和能源運輸的關鍵海上咽喉要道。近幾個月來，沙國將大部分原油出口通過紅海運輸，取代被伊朗控制的荷姆茲海峽航線。
分析人士表示，沙國「不會容忍這一封鎖持續下去」，因為葉門叛軍胡塞的行動威脅這一重要替代石油出口路線。
沙國國防部表示，43 個國家和歐盟的代表出席了討論該聯盟提案的國際會議，確定沙烏地阿拉伯將作為創始國和領導國，並承擔總部所在地職責。
該部強調，聯盟將致力於加強海上安全，確保國際貿易航線和能源供應線穩定，並保護曼德海峽和亞丁灣的共同海上利益。
土耳其、巴基斯坦、埃及、蘇丹等 14 個國家發表了聯合聲明，支持該聯盟提案。在六個波斯灣阿拉伯國家中，阿曼和阿聯未被列入支持該聲明的國家名單。
胡塞於 7 月 20 日表示將在紅海區域對沙國實施海上封鎖，此後聲稱對多艘與沙國有關的船隻發動了一系列襲擊。沙國以空襲作為回應，稱其襲擊了葉門荷台達用於威脅商業航運的胡塞軍事設施。
在沙國油輪遭到襲擊後，其他船隻不得不選擇掉頭或改走經蘇伊士運河的更遠、成本更高的航線。持續數月的戰爭已使石油貿易承壓。
胡塞除襲擊油輪外，最近還宣稱攻擊了沙國石油設施，包括位於紅海港口城市吉贊和延布的、與石油巨頭 Saudi Aramco 相關的設施。
paras_en: Saudi Arabia announced on Thursday (the 30th) a plan to create a multilateral maritime defense alliance aimed at protecting international shipping and energy supply routes in the Red Sea.

The Bab al-Mandeb Strait, which links the southern Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, is a critical maritime choke point for global trade and energy transport. In recent months, Saudi Arabia has routed most of its crude oil exports through the Red Sea, replacing the route through the Hormuz Strait that is controlled by Iran.
Analysts say Saudi Arabia "will not tolerate this blockade continuing," because the actions of Yemen's Houthi rebels threaten this important alternative oil export corridor.

The Saudi Ministry of Defense said representatives from 43 countries and the European Union attended an international conference to discuss the alliance proposal, confirming that Saudi Arabia will serve as a founding and leading member and will host the alliance’s headquarters.

The ministry emphasized that the alliance will work to strengthen maritime security, ensure the stability of international trade routes and energy supply lines, and protect the shared maritime interests of the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and the Gulf of Aden.

Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Sudan and ten other countries issued a joint statement supporting the alliance proposal. Among the six Gulf Arab states, Oman and the United Arab Emirates were not listed among the supporters.

On July 20, the Houthis announced they would impose a maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia in the Red Sea region, and later claimed to have launched a series of attacks on several vessels linked to Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia responded with airstrikes, saying it hit Houthi military facilities in Yemen’s Hodeidah that were being used to threaten commercial shipping.
After a Saudi oil tanker was attacked, other vessels were forced to turn back or take the longer, more costly route via the Suez Canal. The months‑long war has put pressure on oil trade.

In addition to targeting oil tankers, the Houthis recently claimed to have attacked Saudi oil facilities, including sites in the Red Sea port city of Jizan and in Yanbu that are associated with oil giant Saudi Aramco.

items.title: 首納國內資產！韓政府擬砸20兆韓元注資主權財富基金KIC 韓股單日狂飆17.9%創歷史紀錄
items.title_en: S. Korean Gov't to Invest 20 Trillion Won in Sovereign Wealth Fund KIC, Boosting Domestic Assets
paras: 連三天挫跌的南韓綜合股指 (KOSPI) 今(31)日大幅反彈收高 17.9%，一舉收復 6500 點大關，並創史上單日最大漲幅紀錄，三星電子與 SK 海力士均上漲超過 23%，追隨昨晚美國晶片股創下的一年多來單日最大漲勢，且首爾當局今日宣布將向主權財富基金「韓國投資公司」(KIC)大舉注資。
南韓政府今日發出聲明宣布，將向 KIC 注入 20 兆韓元 (約 139 億美元)，在 KIC 現有架構下新設專項帳戶，專門投資 AI、資料中心與基礎建設，而最具代表性的是，KIC 投資授權將首次從純海外配置延伸至國內資產，宣告南韓主權資本戰略轉向。
新設專項帳戶初始規模至少達 20 兆韓元，資金來自政策性銀行等公股機構股權出資，管理上與 KIC 既有的外匯儲備組合嚴格隔離、獨立決策。
南韓政府擬最快 8 月向國會提交《韓國投資公司法》修訂草案，目標明年正式運作。KIC 去年底管理資產 2320 億美元，過去僅管海外儲備，如今被定位為「錨定投資者」，用以撬動外國主權基金與資產管理機構跟進佈局南韓 AI 生態。
消息一出，今日盤中 KOSPI 一度飆漲 17%，三星電子、SK 海力士雙雙暴漲，觸發 Sidecar 暫停程式交易。
南韓政府雖未明言救市，但注資 AI 與半導體鏈、鬆綁國內投資禁令，被視為繼穩市基金評估後最實質的籌碼。
分析人士指出，在全球 AI 投資格局固化前以主權資本卡位，既替戰略產業補長錢，也為外資入韓提供信用背書，而「國家隊」下場買未來，正成為首爾抵禦波動的新底牌。
paras_en: The South Korean composite stock index (KOSPI) rebounded sharply today (31st), rising 17.9% and regaining the 6,500-point mark, setting a record for the largest single-day gain in history. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix both surged over 23%, following the overnight rally in US chip stocks. The Seoul authorities announced today that they will invest heavily in the sovereign wealth fund, Korea Investment Corporation (KIC).

The South Korean government announced that it will inject 20 trillion won (approximately $13.9 billion) into KIC, establishing a new special account under the existing KIC framework to invest in AI, data centers, and infrastructure. Notably, KIC's investment mandate will be extended from purely overseas investments to domestic assets for the first time, marking a shift in South Korea's sovereign capital strategy.

The new special account will have an initial size of at least 20 trillion won, funded by equity investments from policy banks and other public institutions. The management of the account will be strictly isolated from KIC's existing foreign exchange reserve portfolio, with independent decision-making.

The South Korean government plans to submit a revised draft of the Korea Investment Corporation Act to the National Assembly as early as August, aiming to launch the new initiative next year. KIC managed $232 billion in assets at the end of last year, previously focusing only on overseas reserves. It is now positioned as an 'anchor investor' to attract foreign sovereign funds and asset management institutions to invest in South Korea's AI ecosystem.

Upon the announcement, the KOSPI index soared 17% during the session, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix surging, triggering a temporary trading halt. Although the government did not explicitly state that it is intervening in the market, the investment in AI and semiconductors, as well as the relaxation of domestic investment restrictions, is seen as the most substantial move since the evaluation of the market stabilization fund.

Analysts point out that by using sovereign capital to secure a position in the global AI investment landscape before it becomes solidified, South Korea can provide long-term funding for its strategic industries and offer credit guarantees for foreign investors. The 'national team' is now buying into the future, becoming Seoul's new trump card in resisting market volatility.

items.title: 黃仁勳自爆「超內向」：沒有開源就沒今天的AI  記憶體已成AI最大瓶頸
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Reveals He's "Super Introverted": No Open Source, No Today's AI; Memory Has Become AI's Biggest Bottleneck
paras: 輝達創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳週一 (27 日) 出席「Y Combinator」播客節目時談到對 AI 的看法和理念，並談及個人人生觀。
在聊完 Waymo 自動駕駛汽車後，主持人說：「我想藉這個機會稍稍停一下。我們這裡正好有一群觀眾，或許台下的你們可以歡迎黃仁勳加入 X 平台，他應該也發了自己的第一條帖子。」
黃仁勳上周五 (24 日) 正式入駐 X 平台，發布的首條帖文是輝達簽署的公開信，主要講述開源模型為何重要。「世界需要先進閉源模型，也需要先進開源模型。」
黃仁勳對此回應稱：「你知道的，這恰好說明了我有多麼內向。我 2026 年才在 X 平台發布第一條貼文，也可能是地球上最後一個這麼做的人，但我要發的東西實在是太重要了，對整個行業、整個世界來說都很重要。所以我才克服自己的害羞，終於在 X 上發布了第一條內容。」
他繼續說道：「如果沒有開源，行動互聯網和雲端運算產業根本不存在。如果沒有開放生態、沒有 Linux、Kubernetes、TensorFlow、PyTorch，我不敢想現在會怎樣。你要知道，所有這些東西都是開源的。如果沒有這些，我們怎麼可能在今天擁抱 AI？」
黃仁勳周一也指出，記憶體晶片已成為 AI 發展的最大瓶頸。隨著 AI 任務向複雜智能體與情境處理演進，HBM 對資料儲存與快速檢索的關鍵性日益凸顯。
此前，輝達靠著 GPU 奠定 AI 算力優勢，如今已轉向構建集成記憶體晶片的系統，需依賴美光、SK 海力士及三星等供應商的穩定大批量供應，但專用記憶體晶片產能有限，供應受限可能衝擊輝達的產品交付速度。
市場人士則分析認為，此為 AI 演進自然階段，輝達仍具長期主導潛力。
paras_en: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang appeared on a Y Combinator podcast on Monday (the 27th) to discuss his views and philosophy on AI as well as his personal outlook on life.

After talking about Waymo's self‑driving cars, the host said, "I’d like to take a brief pause. We have an audience here, and maybe those of you in the room can welcome Jensen Huang to the X platform; he should have just posted his first tweet there."

Jensen Huang officially joined X last Friday (the 24th) and his first post was a public letter signed by Nvidia that explained why open‑source models matter. "The world needs advanced closed‑source models, and it also needs advanced open‑source models," it said.

Huang responded, "You know, that just shows how introverted I am. I only posted my first thing on X in 2026, and I might be the last person on Earth to do that, but what I have to share is just too important—for the whole industry and the world. So I pushed past my shyness and finally posted my first content on X."

He continued, "If there were no open source, the mobile internet and cloud computing industries would not exist. If there were no open ecosystems, no Linux, Kubernetes, TensorFlow, PyTorch, I can’t imagine what things would be like today. You have to understand that all of those are open source. Without them, how could we be embracing AI today?"

On Monday, Huang also pointed out that memory chips have become the biggest bottleneck for AI development. As AI tasks evolve toward more complex agents and contextual processing, the importance of HBM for data storage and rapid retrieval is becoming increasingly evident.

Previously, Nvidia built its AI compute advantage on GPUs; now it is shifting to building systems that integrate memory chips, relying on steady, high‑volume supply from suppliers such as Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung. However, dedicated memory chip capacity is limited, and supply constraints could affect Nvidia’s product delivery speed.
Market analysts say this is a natural stage in AI’s evolution and that Nvidia still has long‑term dominant potential.

items.title: 繼OpenAI後再爆資安危機！Claude設錯外網權限 駭入三家公司
items.title_en: Another Security Crisis After OpenAI! Claude Misconfigured External Network Access Leads to Hacks of Three Companies
paras: Anthropic 周四 (30 日) 表示，旗下人工智慧 (AI) 模型 Claude 因為設定錯誤，在測試期間取得網際網路存取權限，進而入侵了三家公司的系統，這是繼競爭對手 OpenAI 入侵 Hugging Face 之後，AI 引發的最新資安事件。
Anthropic 表示，原本應與外部網路隔離的測試環境，因設定錯誤讓 Claude 模型得以連上網際網路，並對三家機構的系統進行未經授權的存取。
OpenAI 上周披露 AI 代理在安全測試期間失控並入侵 Hugging Face 基礎設施之後，Anthropic 展開全面審查並檢視 14 萬 1006 次測試紀錄，最終發現此事。
這些事件凸顯出 AI 能力快速提升所帶來的資安風險，已從專家過去擔憂的理論情境演變為現實，就連頂尖 AI 開發商也可能因模型利用系統漏洞而措手不及。
Anthropic 表示，Claude 利用弱密碼及未經身分驗證的端點等基本手法，成功入侵受影響公司的基礎設施。這起事件涉及三個不同模型，包括 Claude Opus 4.7、Claude Mythos 5 及一款內部研究模型。最早案例可追溯至今年 4 月，都發生在缺乏 Anthropic 所稱「標準防護措施」的測試環境中。
這些入侵發生於俗稱「Capture the Flag」(CTF，奪旗攻防) 的資安演練。該測試要求 AI 模型在模擬網路中尋找隱藏資訊。Anthropic 表示，測試提示明確告知模型無法連接網際網路，但由於與合作測試夥伴 Irregular 間出現溝通誤解，實際測試環境仍連接至公共網路。
Anthropic 從 7 月 23 日開始檢視測試紀錄，並在同日發現 Claude 可能已連上網路後，立即暫停所有資安測試。該公司已在 7 月 24 日前確認總計共三起事件，並於 7 月 27 日通知受影響機構。
Anthropic 指出，其中兩家公司在接獲通知前並不知道遭到存取，目前仍持續聯繫第三家受影響機構。
Anthropic 表示，隨著 AI 模型愈來愈具備執行真實世界網路攻擊的能力，無論企業內部或第三方測試環境，都必須建立更嚴格的安全控管機制。
paras_en: Anthropic said on Thursday (the 30th) that its artificial intelligence (AI) model Claude mistakenly gained internet access during testing, allowing it to breach the systems of three companies. This follows a rival AI security incident in which OpenAI’s agents infiltrated Hugging Face’s infrastructure.

Anthropic explained that a test environment that should have been isolated from external networks was misconfigured, letting the Claude model connect to the internet and perform unauthorized access to the systems of three organizations.

After OpenAI disclosed last week that an AI agent went rogue during a security test and compromised Hugging Face’s infrastructure, Anthropic conducted a comprehensive review of 141,006 test logs and ultimately uncovered the incident.

These events highlight the cybersecurity risks posed by rapidly advancing AI capabilities, turning what experts once warned as theoretical scenarios into reality, and showing that even top AI developers can be caught off‑guard by models exploiting system vulnerabilities.

Anthropic said Claude used basic techniques such as weak passwords and unauthenticated endpoints to successfully infiltrate the affected companies’ infrastructure. The breach involved three different models: Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an internal research model. The earliest case dates back to April of this year, all occurring in test environments lacking what Anthropic calls “standard protective measures.”

The intrusions took place during a security exercise commonly known as “Capture the Flag” (CTF). The test required the AI model to locate hidden information within a simulated network. Anthropic noted that the test instructions explicitly told the model it could not access the internet, but a communication misunderstanding with testing partner Irregular resulted in the environment remaining connected to the public internet.

Anthropic began reviewing test logs on July 23 and, upon discovering that Claude might have connected to the internet that same day, immediately halted all security testing. The company confirmed a total of three incidents by July 24 and notified the affected organizations on July 27.
Anthropic indicated that two of the companies were unaware they had been accessed until they received the notification, and it is still in contact with the third affected organization.

Anthropic warned that as AI models become increasingly capable of carrying out real‑world network attacks, stricter security controls must be established in both internal corporate environments and third‑party testing setups.

items.title: 馬斯克再展鈔能力 砸1億美元拉抬川普期中選情
items.title_en: Musk Invests $100 Million to Boost Trump's Midterm Election Chances
paras: 《紐約時報》30 日報導，由特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克支持的親川普政治團體「美國政治行動委員會」（America PAC），正計畫投入高達 1.2 億美元，全力為 11 月的國會期中選舉衝高共和黨選民投票率。
儘管歷史趨勢顯示，期中選舉往往對在野黨有利，但該委員會在給予路透社的聲明中強調，共和黨仍有十足把握保住國會多數席次，並預計在催票行動中扮演關鍵角色。
該委員會發言人羅密歐（Andrew Romeo）表示，很榮幸能再次成為團隊的一員。雖然他拒絕透露支出細節，但證實了 Axios 此前的一項報導，即該組織正計畫在「掃街拜票」、數位廣告及直接郵寄行銷上進行巨額投資，藉此激發保守派選民的投票意願。
這項行動將成為 2026 年期中選舉規模最大的外部資金投入之一，也進一步鞏固馬斯克作為共和黨最具影響力金主之一的地位。這位特斯拉與 SpaceX 執行長在 2024 年大選期間投入大量資金，協助川普及其他共和黨候選人勝選。
鑑於川普當前的支持率下滑，且選民對經濟狀況感到不滿，共和黨目前正面臨與民主黨之間的「熱情落差」，而民主黨正蓄勢待發，試圖奪取國會兩院的控制權。
馬斯克的資金挹注，無疑將成為共和黨凝聚選民信心的一大強心針。據兩名消息人士向《紐約時報》透露，這項催票計畫將橫跨至少八個州，且馬斯克已核准 1 億至 1.2 億美元的專案預算。
根據路透社查閱的聯邦競選財務申報文件顯示，該委員會自 2025 年元旦以來已花費 5,230 萬美元，本屆選舉週期累積募資額達 5,030 萬美元，其中約 5,000 萬美元皆直接來自馬斯克個人。
根據美國選舉法規，所謂的「超級政治行動委員會」（Super PAC）可無上限接受個人與企業捐款，支出金額亦無限制，但不得與候選人陣營進行直接協調。
身為全球首富的馬斯克，在本次期中選舉已個人捐贈超過 8,500 萬美元，其中包括提供給「美國政治行動委員會」的資金。
值得注意的是，馬斯克旗下的火箭與衛星公司 SpaceX 是重要的政府承包商，其約 20% 的營收源自美國政府。
paras_en: According to a report by The New York Times on the 30th, the pro-Trump political group "America PAC", supported by Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Musk, plans to invest up to $120 million to boost Republican voter turnout in the November midterm elections.

Despite historical trends showing that midterm elections often favor the opposition party, the committee emphasized in a statement to Reuters that the Republicans are confident of retaining their majority in Congress and are expected to play a key role in get-out-the-vote efforts.

Committee spokesman Andrew Romeo stated that he is honored to be part of the team again, and although he declined to disclose spending details, he confirmed a previous report by Axios that the organization plans to make significant investments in door-to-door canvassing, digital advertising, and direct mail marketing to stimulate conservative voter turnout.

This effort will become one of the largest external funding injections in the 2026 midterm elections, further solidifying Musk's position as one of the most influential Republican donors. The Tesla and SpaceX CEO invested heavily in the 2024 presidential election, helping Trump and other Republican candidates win.

Given Trump's current declining approval ratings and voter dissatisfaction with the economy, the Republicans are facing an "enthusiasm gap" with the Democrats, who are poised to take control of both houses of Congress.

Musk's funding is likely to be a major boost to Republican voter confidence. According to two sources, the get-out-the-vote plan will span at least eight states, with Musk approving a project budget of $100 million to $120 million.

According to federal campaign finance filings reviewed by Reuters, the committee has spent $52.3 million since January 1, 2025, and has raised $50.3 million in this election cycle, with nearly $50 million coming directly from Musk.
Under US election laws, so-called "super PACs" can accept unlimited personal and corporate donations and have no spending limits, but are not allowed to coordinate directly with candidate campaigns.
As the world's richest person, Musk has personally donated over $85 million in this midterm election, including funds provided to "America PAC".
Notably, Musk's rocket and satellite company SpaceX is a major government contractor, with around 20% of its revenue coming from the US government.

items.title: 日本央行維持利率不變 下修通膨預期但保留後續升息空間
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged, Lowers Inflation Forecast but Leaves Room for Future Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行在周五 (31 日) 的金融政策決定會議上，以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，此舉反映出日銀在 6 月升息後，傾向於觀察其對經濟與物價情勢的影響，並對中東衝突與日元匯率保持謹慎態度。
受周五決定的影響，日元走弱，美元兌日元匯率上漲 0.7%。
在本次會議中，審議委員高田創是唯一的反對者。他提議將利率提高至 1.25% 左右，認為隨著海外金融政策轉向及國內物價上行風險增加，日本已進入需要機動調整政策的「新階段」，但此案最終被多數否決。
根據日銀同步發布的「經濟與物價情勢展望報告」，政策委員將 2026 年度實質國內總生產 (GDP) 人工智慧 (AI) 相關需求的增加，以及政府補助政策對國內消費的支撐。
在物價方面，2026 年度的核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 預測則從原先的 2.8% 下修至 2.5%。這主要是受到東京政府實施公用事業補貼的影響，短期內減緩了通膨壓力。然而，日銀指出，隨著薪資與物價良性循環的維持，基調物價預計在 2026 年底至 2027 年度趨於 2% 的目標水準。
儘管本次維持利率不變，日銀強調若經濟與物價展望如期實現，將繼續提高政策利率，以調整金融寬鬆程度。日銀特別提到，日元貶值及 AI 帶動的半導體價格上漲，仍可能導致物價「上行風險」大於下行風險，甚至有超越 2% 目標的可能性。
市場分析師對此持鷹派解讀，凱投宏觀 (Capital Economics) 分析指出，日銀的評論暗示後續仍有升息可能，預測下一次行動可能落在 10 月，且利率有望在明年底達到 2%。日銀未來將密切關注中東局勢、匯率波動及 AI 產業動向，做為調整政策節奏的依據。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan decided to keep its policy interest rate unchanged at 1.0% with an overwhelming majority of 8 to 1 at its monetary policy meeting on Friday, reflecting its intention to observe the impact of its previous rate hike in June on the economy and prices, and to remain cautious about the Middle East conflict and yen exchange rate.
The decision led to a weakening of the yen, with the dollar-yen exchange rate rising 0.7% on Friday.

The only dissenter in the meeting was committee member Takashi Kadota, who proposed raising the interest rate to around 1.25%, citing the need for flexible policy adjustments as Japan enters a 'new phase' with increasing risks of higher prices at home and a shift in overseas monetary policies, but his proposal was rejected by the majority.

According to the 'Economic and Price Outlook' report released by the Bank of Japan at the same time, policymakers expect the increase in demand related to artificial intelligence (AI) and government subsidy policies to support domestic consumption in the 2026 fiscal year.

In terms of prices, the forecast for the core consumer price index (CPI) in the 2026 fiscal year was revised down from 2.8% to 2.5%, mainly due to the impact of the Tokyo government's implementation of public utility subsidies, which has eased inflationary pressure in the short term. However, the Bank of Japan pointed out that with the maintenance of a virtuous cycle of wages and prices, the underlying inflation rate is expected to approach the 2% target level by the end of 2026 to 2027.

Although the interest rate was left unchanged this time, the Bank of Japan emphasized that if the economic and price outlook is as expected, it will continue to raise policy interest rates to adjust the degree of monetary easing. The Bank of Japan particularly noted that the depreciation of the yen and the rise in semiconductor prices driven by AI may still lead to 'upside risks' to prices, even exceeding the 2% target.

Market analysts took a hawkish view of this, with Capital Economics analysts pointing out that the Bank of Japan's comments suggest that there is still a possibility of further rate hikes, predicting that the next action may come in October, and that interest rates are expected to reach 2% by the end of next year. The Bank of Japan will closely watch the situation in the Middle East, exchange rate fluctuations, and trends in the AI industry as the basis for adjusting the pace of policy.

items.title: AI晶片產能快被搶光！供應鏈進入「預付款時代」：簽千億美元鎖定 半導體權力格局正在重塑
items.title_en: AI Chip Capacity Is Being Snatched Up! The Supply Chain Enters a “Pre‑Payment Era”: Trillions of Dollars Locked In, Semiconductor Power Dynamics Are Being Reshaped
paras: 全球 AI 晶片的競爭已經超越單純的架構與算力比拼，悄然下沉至供應鏈深處一場關於「稀缺產能」的隱秘戰爭。
從晶圓代工、HBM、先進封裝到硅光材料，未來三到五年的核心產能正被重量級企業以預付款、長約 (LTA) 甚至股權投資的形式大規模鎖定，這不僅標誌著傳統買賣關係的終結，更預示著半導體產業權力格局的根本性重構。
從輝達累計高達 1190 億美元的供應鏈承諾，到美光的 16 份戰略客戶協議，再到三星與博通開創的「記憶體 + 代工 + 封裝」一體化交付，Soitec 的矽光材料供給所收取的預付款，無不證明產能已不再是買賣關係，而是戰略資產。
為了鎖定產能，廠商們正在各出奇招，而所謂的「預付款時代」，本質是一場全行業參與的「產能劃界運動」，下游客戶透過真金白銀的深度綁定，換取未來數年的產能優先權與技術話語權。
輝達堪稱此中模範。截至今年 4 月，其製造與供應承諾總額高達 1190 億美元，其中 950 億美元將於當前財年支付，本月也再與封測巨頭 Amkor 簽署 15 億美元協議，提供預付款助其擴充美國先進封裝產能，並協調技術路線圖。
這種策略早已延伸至光互連領域；輝達向 Coherent 投資 20 億美元，並簽署數十億美元採購協議，鎖定未來產能，其競爭壁壘已從 CUDA 軟體生態擴展至動用現金組織供應鏈的系統能力。
記憶體大廠則選擇以合約鎖定未來。美光已簽署 16 份「照付不議」(Take-or-Pay) 戰略客戶協議，剩餘履約義務約 1000 億美元，並收取約 180 億美元現金預付款，鎖定未來 20% 的 DRAM 與三分之一的 NAND 產量。這些設有價格上下限的協議，料將佔美光總營收 50% 以上，極大增強其定價權與抗週期能力。
SK 海力士同樣跟 10 家左右客戶簽下五年長約，該公司 HBM4 出貨放量助推上半年營收首破 100 兆韓元，大幅年增 257%。
最具顛覆性的是三星與博通的合作。雙方於 7 月簽署備忘錄，打算到 2030 年在記憶體、代工、封裝領域投入超 2000 億美元，這打破了傳統採購模式。
過去，博通必須分別向不同廠商採購邏輯晶片、HBM 並外包封裝，如今三星憑藉其獨有的「端到端」半導體能力，提供涵蓋 2 奈米製程、2.5D/3D 集成的「一體化交付」，這標誌著長期綁定已從單點產能，升級為整條 AI 晶片製造體系的深度融合。
綁定潮更向上游蔓延。矽光材料龍頭 Soitec 披露，其光子 SOI 銷售額年增率翻倍，正收取客戶預付款以擴產，這釋放出強烈信號：即便共封裝光學 (CPO) 尚未放量，其核心基材產能已被提前預訂。

驅動變革的是，AI 晶片形態與產業邏輯的根本轉變；一，AI 加速器已成為高度複雜的系統工程，涉及先進製程、HBM、2.5D/3D 封裝、矽光晶片等多個環節，任一環節缺料皆可導致整線停擺。台積電董事長魏哲家坦言，先進封裝產能緊張已限制客戶增長，並因此將 2026 年資本開支上調至 600 億美元以上，其中一成至兩成投向封裝測試；二，AI 產能日益專用化，HBM 堆疊、封裝設計、測試程序均需與特定客戶協同定制，供應商不敢僅憑市場預測盲目擴產；三，晶片迭代速度與建廠週期嚴重錯配，迫使客戶以長約換取供應確定性。
專家分析指出，新法則正在重塑產業生態。對上游廠商而言，預付款帶來擴產資金、穩定稼動率與可預測現金流，但也犧牲了現貨價格暴漲時的利潤彈性，並加深對重量級客戶的依賴。
對輝達、博通等巨頭，鎖定產能意味著確保出貨節奏、掌握技術定義權，但必須承擔需求不及預期時的合約違約風險與鉅額資金佔用。
衝擊最大的恐怕是中小晶片企業。當主要大廠以五年合約和百億預付款圈定核心資源後，中小公司可能面臨無產能可買、價高者得、交期延長甚至被迫使用落後製程困境。「設計出晶片」已不再是唯一門檻，能否憑藉資產負債表鎖定供應鏈，正成為新的生死線。
至於長約是否會終結半導體週期，專家給出否定答案，認為長約僅改變了風險表現形式。從過去的庫存積壓、價格暴跌，轉為未來的合約重談、預付款減值與產能閒置。
更需警惕的是「重複預訂」風險，客戶為防缺貨可能向多家供應商過度下單，誤導全行業擴產。魏哲家表示，台積電如今不僅聽取客戶需求數字，更核查數據中心建設進度與電力部署，以防晶片最終變為庫存。
值得注意的是，客戶正成為半導體擴產的第四類出資人，與企業現金流、銀行借貸、政府補貼並列。這種深度的資本與產能同盟，恐將推動 AI 晶片產業從「市場驅動」的週期性波動，轉向「資本綁定」的結構性競爭新時代。在這場靜水流深的變革中，贏家通吃局面恐將加速到來。
paras_en: Global competition for AI chips has moved beyond pure architecture and compute power battles and has quietly sunk into the depths of the supply chain, where a hidden war over “scarce capacity” is unfolding.

From wafer foundries, HBM, advanced packaging to silicon‑photonic materials, the core capacity for the next three to five years is being locked down on a massive scale by heavyweight players through pre‑payments, long‑term agreements (LTAs) and even equity investments. This not only marks the end of traditional buyer‑seller relationships but also signals a fundamental reshaping of the semiconductor industry’s power structure.

From Nvidia’s cumulative $119 billion supply‑chain commitments, to Micron’s 16 strategic‑customer agreements, to Samsung and Broadcom’s pioneering “memory + foundry + packaging” integrated delivery, and to the pre‑payments Soitec receives for its silicon‑photonic materials, all evidence that capacity is no longer a simple trade item but a strategic asset.

To lock in capacity, vendors are resorting to all sorts of tactics. The so‑called “pre‑payment era” is essentially an industry‑wide “capacity demarcation movement,” where downstream customers bind themselves with real cash to secure priority access and technical influence for the coming years.

Nvidia is a prime example. By April this year, its manufacturing and supply commitments totalled $119 billion, with $95 billion payable in the current fiscal year. This month it also signed a $1.5 billion deal with packaging giant Amkor, providing pre‑payment to help expand advanced packaging capacity in the United States and to coordinate the technology roadmap.

The strategy has already extended into the optical‑interconnect space; Nvidia invested $2 billion in Coherent and signed multi‑billion‑dollar purchase agreements to lock in future capacity, expanding its competitive moat from the CUDA software ecosystem to a cash‑driven ability to organize the supply chain.

Memory giants are opting for contract‑based capacity locks. Micron has signed 16 “take‑or‑pay” strategic‑customer agreements covering roughly $100 billion of remaining obligations and has collected about $18 billion in cash pre‑payments, securing 20% of future DRAM and one‑third of NAND output. These price‑capped contracts are expected to account for more than 50% of Micron’s total revenue, greatly enhancing its pricing power and cyclicality resilience.
SK Hynix has similarly signed five‑year LTAs with around ten customers; its HBM4 shipments surged, helping first‑half revenue break the 100 trillion‑won mark, a year‑over‑year increase of 257%.

The most disruptive development is the Samsung‑Broadcom partnership. In July the two signed a memorandum of understanding to invest over $200 billion by 2030 in memory, foundry and packaging, breaking away from traditional procurement models.

Historically Broadcom had to source logic chips, HBM and outsource packaging from different suppliers. Now Samsung, leveraging its unique end‑to‑end semiconductor capabilities, offers an integrated delivery covering 2‑nm processes and 2.5D/3D integration, marking a shift from single‑point capacity binding to deep integration across the entire AI‑chip manufacturing ecosystem.

The binding trend is moving upstream. Soitec, a leader in silicon‑photonic materials, disclosed that its photonic‑SOI sales grew at a double‑digit annual rate and that it is taking pre‑payments from customers to expand capacity. This sends a strong signal: even though co‑packaged optics (CPO) has not yet scaled, the core substrate capacity is already being pre‑booked.

The driver of this change is the fundamental transformation of AI‑chip form factors and industry logic. First, AI accelerators have become highly complex system‑engineered products involving advanced nodes, HBM, 2.5D/3D packaging and silicon‑photonic chips; a shortage at any link can halt the entire line. TSMC chairman Wei Zhejia admitted that tight advanced‑packaging capacity is limiting customer growth, prompting the company to raise its 2026 capital expenditure to over $60 billion, with 10‑20% earmarked for packaging and testing. Second, AI capacity is becoming increasingly specialized; HBM stacking, package design and test flows must be co‑developed with specific customers, so suppliers cannot blindly expand based on market forecasts. Third, the mismatch between chip iteration speed and fab construction cycles forces customers to use long‑term contracts to secure supply certainty.

Experts say new rules are reshaping the ecosystem. For upstream firms, pre‑payments provide expansion capital, stable utilization and predictable cash flow, but they sacrifice profit flexibility when spot prices spike and deepen dependence on heavyweight customers.

For giants like Nvidia and Broadcom, locking capacity ensures shipment cadence and control over technical definitions, but also exposes them to contract‑default risk and large capital lock‑up if demand falls short of expectations.

The biggest impact will likely be on small‑ and medium‑size chip companies. Once the majors lock core resources with five‑year contracts and billions in pre‑payments, SMEs may find no capacity to buy, face higher prices, longer lead times or be forced to use older processes. Designing a chip is no longer the sole hurdle; the ability to lock the supply chain with balance‑sheet strength becomes a new survival line.

Will long‑term contracts end the semiconductor cycle? Experts say no; they merely change the risk profile. Instead of inventory build‑ups and price crashes, the future will see contract renegotiations, pre‑payment impairments and idle capacity.

Another risk is “double‑booking”: customers may over‑order from multiple suppliers to avoid shortages, misleading the whole industry into over‑expansion. Wei Zhejia noted that TSMC now not only listens to customer demand numbers but also verifies data‑center construction progress and power‑deployment plans to prevent chips from ending up as excess inventory.

It is noteworthy that customers are becoming the fourth type of investor in semiconductor capacity expansion, alongside corporate cash flow, bank loans and government subsidies. This deep capital‑capacity alliance could push the AI‑chip industry from a market‑driven cyclical model toward a structurally competitive “capital‑bound” era. In this subtle yet profound transformation, a winner‑takes‑all landscape may accelerate rapidly.

items.title: 日本央行維持利率不變 下修通膨預期但保留後續升息空間
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged, Lowers Inflation Forecast but Leaves Room for Future Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行在周五 (31 日) 的金融政策決定會議上，以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，此舉反映出日銀在 6 月升息後，傾向於觀察其對經濟與物價情勢的影響，並對中東衝突與日元匯率保持謹慎態度。
受周五決定的影響，日元走弱，美元兌日元匯率上漲 0.7%。
在本次會議中，審議委員高田創是唯一的反對者。他提議將利率提高至 1.25% 左右，認為隨著海外金融政策轉向及國內物價上行風險增加，日本已進入需要機動調整政策的「新階段」，但此案最終被多數否決。
根據日銀同步發布的「經濟與物價情勢展望報告」，政策委員將 2026 年度實質國內總生產 (GDP) 人工智慧 (AI) 相關需求的增加，以及政府補助政策對國內消費的支撐。
在物價方面，2026 年度的核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 預測則從原先的 2.8% 下修至 2.5%。這主要是受到東京政府實施公用事業補貼的影響，短期內減緩了通膨壓力。然而，日銀指出，隨著薪資與物價良性循環的維持，基調物價預計在 2026 年底至 2027 年度趨於 2% 的目標水準。
儘管本次維持利率不變，日銀強調若經濟與物價展望如期實現，將繼續提高政策利率，以調整金融寬鬆程度。日銀特別提到，日元貶值及 AI 帶動的半導體價格上漲，仍可能導致物價「上行風險」大於下行風險，甚至有超越 2% 目標的可能性。
市場分析師對此持鷹派解讀，凱投宏觀 (Capital Economics) 分析指出，日銀的評論暗示後續仍有升息可能，預測下一次行動可能落在 10 月，且利率有望在明年底達到 2%。日銀未來將密切關注中東局勢、匯率波動及 AI 產業動向，做為調整政策節奏的依據。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan decided to keep its policy interest rate unchanged at 1.0% with an overwhelming majority of 8 to 1 at its monetary policy meeting on Friday, reflecting its intention to observe the impact of its previous rate hike in June on the economy and prices, and to remain cautious about the Middle East conflict and yen exchange rate.
The decision led to a weakening of the yen, with the dollar-yen exchange rate rising 0.7% on Friday.

The only dissenter in the meeting was committee member Takashi Kadota, who proposed raising the interest rate to around 1.25%, citing the need for flexible policy adjustments as Japan enters a 'new phase' with increasing risks of higher prices at home and a shift in overseas monetary policies, but his proposal was rejected by the majority.

According to the 'Economic and Price Outlook' report released by the Bank of Japan at the same time, policymakers expect the increase in demand related to artificial intelligence (AI) and government subsidy policies to support domestic consumption in the 2026 fiscal year.

In terms of prices, the forecast for the core consumer price index (CPI) in the 2026 fiscal year was revised down from 2.8% to 2.5%, mainly due to the impact of the Tokyo government's implementation of public utility subsidies, which has eased inflationary pressure in the short term. However, the Bank of Japan pointed out that with the maintenance of a virtuous cycle of wages and prices, the underlying inflation rate is expected to approach the 2% target level by the end of 2026 to 2027.

Although the interest rate was left unchanged this time, the Bank of Japan emphasized that if the economic and price outlook is as expected, it will continue to raise policy interest rates to adjust the degree of monetary easing. The Bank of Japan particularly noted that the depreciation of the yen and the rise in semiconductor prices driven by AI may still lead to 'upside risks' to prices, even exceeding the 2% target.

Market analysts took a hawkish view of this, with Capital Economics analysts pointing out that the Bank of Japan's comments suggest that there is still a possibility of further rate hikes, predicting that the next action may come in October, and that interest rates are expected to reach 2% by the end of next year. The Bank of Japan will closely watch the situation in the Middle East, exchange rate fluctuations, and trends in the AI industry as the basis for adjusting the pace of policy.

items.title: 日元狂升500點是假反轉？美日匯市角力透露下一波行情關鍵
items.title_en: Is the 500-Point Surge in the Yen a False Reversal? The Struggle in the US-Japan Forex Market Reveals the Key to the Next Trend
paras: 就在日本央行週五 (31 日) 公布利率決議前夕，日元匯率出現劇烈反彈。市場消息顯示，日本當局可能在週四紐約交易時段再次出手干預外匯市場，而這次行動疑似獲得美國方面支持。
週四紐約交易時段，日元 / 美元 (JPYUSD) 一度急升逾 500 點，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來最大盤中漲幅。根據日本當地知情人士透露，此次干預目的在於提振日元匯率；與此同時，美國當局於東京時間凌晨 2 點 30 分左右進行「匯率詢價」（rate checks），此舉通常被市場視為美方可能準備介入匯市的前兆訊號。
市場人士認為，美方的相關行動提升了此次日本干預的市場影響力，也可能促使交易員在操作日元時更加謹慎。
美國財政部長斯貝森特週四受訪時表示，他認為日元「似乎被嚴重低估」，並指出匯率「過度波動」並不健康。
日本最高外匯官員三村淳週五被問及是否實施匯市干預時，並未正面回應，但表示日本從美國獲得的不僅僅是道義上的支持。
利率決議前夕精準狙擊
分析人士指出，日本此次選擇在日本央行貨幣政策會議前出手，可能是為了提高干預效果，並藉由突襲方式降低市場預期。
SMBC 日興證券高級外匯與利率策略師丸山凜斗（Rinto Maruyama）表示，在日本央行會議前進行干預，與今年 4 月較透明、容易被市場察覺的干預方式形成明顯差異。
他指出，近期日美兩國長期債券殖利率急升，是日本外匯干預以及美國匯率詢價行動背後的重要因素。另有分析認為，聯準會決議後美元指數意外走弱，也為日本當局進場干預創造較有利環境。
日元雖急升 貶值壓力仍未解除
在此次行情中，美元兌日元匯率一度跌至 157.98，亞洲時段最新交投約 160.67 附近。不過，儘管日元短線大幅反彈，過去 12 個月來日元兌美元仍累計貶值約 6%，在 G10 貨幣中表現墊底。
日本財務大臣片山皋月面對媒體詢問時表示，目前無法透露是否進行匯市干預，但重申當局持續保持高度警戒，隨時準備採取應對措施。
近幾個月來，日元持續承受貶值壓力，主要受到油價上漲、財政赤字，以及日美利率差擴大的影響。儘管日本當局上一季已在公開市場投入創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元（約 734 億美元）買入日元，但匯率仍持續走弱。
動用巨額資金救日元 挑戰全球匯市力量
根據日本財務省外匯儲備資料，日本先前可能動用了持有的外國證券，包括美國國債，作為干預匯市的資金來源。
這筆史無前例的資金規模，不僅凸顯日本面臨的匯率壓力，也反映出在全球每日交易規模達 9.5 兆美元的外匯市場中，單一國家想逆轉市場趨勢的難度。
利差問題未解 日元長線仍面臨考驗
日本自 2022 年重新重返外匯市場支撐日元後，並於 2024 年再次出手，試圖減緩日元兌美元貶值速度。日元長期走弱，主要源於全球央行在疫情後通膨升溫期間陸續升息，但日本央行長期維持負利率政策，以刺激經濟成長。
此次日元異動正值日本央行政策決議前夕，市場原先預期日本央行在上月升息後，將暫時維持利率不變。上月升息後，日本基準利率已升至 1995 年以來最高水準，投資人此前擔憂日本央行在應對通膨方面反應落後。
此外，儘管聯準會本週維持利率不變，市場仍預期今年稍晚可能降息，日美利率差距短期內仍可能維持對日元不利的格局。
對於此次干預效果，三井住友信託銀行紐約交易員山本武尊（Takeru Yamamoto）表示，當局此時出手可能讓外匯投資人重新評估風險，暫時降低拋售日元的意願。
paras_en: Just before the Bank of Japan's interest rate decision on Friday, the yen exchange rate experienced a sharp rebound. Market news showed that Japanese authorities may have intervened in the foreign exchange market again during the New York trading session on Thursday, and this action was suspected to have been supported by the US side.

During the New York trading session on Thursday, the yen/dollar (JPYUSD) once surged by more than 500 points, creating the largest intraday gain since December 2023. According to local informed sources in Japan, the purpose of this intervention was to boost the yen exchange rate; meanwhile, the US authorities conducted 'rate checks' around 2:30 am Tokyo time, which is usually seen by the market as a sign that the US may be preparing to intervene in the forex market.

Market participants believe that the US side's related actions have enhanced the market impact of Japan's intervention and may have prompted traders to be more cautious when operating the yen. US Treasury Secretary Spencent said in an interview on Thursday that he thought the yen was 'severely undervalued' and pointed out that excessive exchange rate fluctuations are unhealthy.

Japan's top foreign exchange official, Michinori Mochizuki, was asked on Friday whether forex intervention was implemented, but did not respond directly, saying that Japan had received more than just moral support from the US.

Analysts pointed out that Japan's choice to intervene before the Bank of Japan's monetary policy meeting may have been to increase the effectiveness of the intervention and reduce market expectations through a surprise attack.

Rinto Maruyama, senior forex and rates strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, said that intervening before the Bank of Japan meeting was significantly different from the more transparent intervention method in April, which was easier for the market to detect.

He pointed out that the recent surge in long-term bond yields in Japan and the US was an important factor behind Japan's forex intervention and the US's rate check action. Another analysis suggested that the unexpected weakness in the US dollar index after the Fed's decision also created a more favorable environment for Japan's intervention.

Although the yen surged, the downward pressure on the currency has not been alleviated. In this trend, the dollar/yen exchange rate once fell to 157.98 and was recently trading around 160.67 in the Asian session. However, despite the yen's short-term sharp rebound, it has accumulated a depreciation of about 6% against the US dollar over the past 12 months, ranking last among G10 currencies.

Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima said when facing media inquiries that he could not disclose whether forex intervention was conducted, but reiterated that the authorities remain highly vigilant and are ready to take countermeasures at any time.

In recent months, the yen has continued to face downward pressure, mainly due to rising oil prices, fiscal deficits, and the widening interest rate differential between Japan and the US. Although the Japanese authorities invested a record 1.173 trillion yen (approximately $7.34 billion) in the open market to buy yen last quarter, the exchange rate continued to weaken.

Using huge funds to save the yen challenges the global forex market's strength. According to the Japanese Ministry of Finance's foreign exchange reserve data, Japan may have used its holdings of foreign securities, including US Treasury bonds, as a funding source for intervening in the forex market.

This unprecedented scale of funds not only highlights the exchange rate pressure Japan faces but also reflects the difficulty for a single country to reverse market trends in the global forex market, where daily trading volume reaches $9.5 trillion.

The interest rate differential problem has not been resolved, and the yen still faces a long-term test. Japan has been back in the forex market to support the yen since 2022 and intervened again in 2024 to slow down the yen's depreciation against the US dollar. The yen's long-term weakness mainly stems from global central banks' rate hikes during the post-pandemic inflation period, while the Bank of Japan has maintained a negative interest rate policy to stimulate economic growth.

This yen fluctuation occurred just before the Bank of Japan's policy decision, and the market had initially expected the Bank of Japan to maintain interest rates unchanged after last month's rate hike. After the rate hike last month, Japan's benchmark interest rate has risen to its highest level since 1995, and investors had previously been concerned that the Bank of Japan was lagging behind in responding to inflation.

Additionally, although the Fed maintained interest rates this week, the market still expects a possible rate cut later this year, and the Japan-US interest rate differential may continue to be unfavorable to the yen in the short term.

Regarding the effect of this intervention, Takeru Yamamoto, a New York trader at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, said that the authorities' intervention at this time may have prompted forex investors to reevaluate risks and temporarily reduced their willingness to sell the yen.

items.title: 韓日聯手干預匯率？韓元兌美元飆升至9個月新高 日元創兩年多單日最大升幅
items.title_en: South Korea and Japan Collaborate on Currency Intervention? Won Surges to 9-Month High Against USD, Yen Sees Largest Single-Day Gain in Over 2 Years
paras: 韓元兌美元匯率今 (31) 日早盤一度升值至九個月高點，此前首爾外匯當局疑似實施了匯率維穩操作。
首爾時間上午 6 點左右，韓元兌美元升值至 1418 韓元，創 2025 年 10 月 20 日以來的最高水準。截至當地時間今日上午 9 時 37 分，韓元兌美元報 1430 韓元。
韓元的升值與日元的上漲同步。在週四 (30 日) 紐約交易時段，日元兌美元匯率一度升值 3.3%，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來的最大盤中升幅紀錄。對此市場普遍猜測日本當局出手干預。
首爾 KB 國民銀行分析師 Lee Min-hyuk 表示，韓元與日元之間的相關性引發了外界猜測，兩國外匯監管機構可能已介入市場。
他並推測說：「韓元和日元隔夜走強「恐顯示韓日當局可能已共同干預」。
市場正屏息等待日本央行 (BOJ) 決議，總裁植田和男的記者會將決定日元這輪反彈是趨勢反轉，還是短暫脈衝。BOJ 預計維持政策利率在 1% 不變，決議可能獲得政策委員會廣泛多數支持。BOJ 也將發布季度展望報告，包含更新的經濟成長和通膨率估值，而受到日本國內活動韌性和 AI 相關投資的強勁需求支撐，決策官員可能上調日本成長預期，
日元大漲後，日本政府不願證實是否在隔夜交易期間干預匯市，但暗示得到了美國官員等海外同行的支持。
日本財務大臣片山皋月今日迴避日元飆升是否是干預結果的問題，僅稱將「保持高度警惕，並採取適當措施」。
隨後不久，日本外匯事務負責人三村淳暗示，一直得到美國同行和其他國家的支持。
三村淳說，「確實意識到，我們從美國獲得的支持不僅僅是道德上的支持」，並稱已透過個人管道與美國當局保持密切聯繫，但拒絕透露更多細節。
paras_en: The South Korean won (KRW) appreciated to a nine-month high against the US dollar in early trading today, following suspected intervention by Seoul's foreign exchange authorities. The won rose to 1,418 KRW per USD around 6:00 am local time, its highest level since October 20, 2025, and was trading at 1,430 KRW per USD as of 9:37 am local time.

The won's gain was synchronized with the yen's (JPY) surge. In Thursday's New York trading session, the yen appreciated 3.3% against the USD, marking its largest intraday gain since December 2023, sparking speculation about potential intervention by Japanese authorities.

Lee Min-hyuk, an analyst at KB Kookmin Bank in Seoul, stated that the correlation between the won and the yen has led to speculation about possible intervention by the foreign exchange authorities of both countries. He further speculated that the overnight strength of the won and the yen might indicate joint intervention by South Korean and Japanese authorities.

The market is eagerly awaiting the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) decision, with Governor Kazuo Ueda's press conference set to determine whether the yen's rebound is a trend reversal or a short-term pulse. The BOJ is expected to maintain its policy rate at 1%, with the decision likely to receive broad support from the policy committee. The BOJ will also release its quarterly outlook report, including updated estimates for economic growth and inflation, which may be revised upward due to strong domestic demand and AI-related investments.

Following the yen's significant surge, the Japanese government declined to confirm whether it had intervened in the currency market during overnight trading but hinted at receiving support from US officials and other overseas counterparts. Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima avoided commenting on whether the yen's surge was a result of intervention, stating only that the government would 'remain highly vigilant and take appropriate measures'.

Soon after, Japan's foreign exchange chief, Junichi Suzuki, suggested that the country had received support from the US and other nations. Suzuki stated, 'We are aware that the support we receive from the US is not just moral support', and mentioned that Japan had maintained close contact with US authorities through personal channels, but refused to disclose further details.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Suspected Japanese Intervention, Yen Rises Over 2%
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國聯邦準備理事會 (FED) 維持利率不變，美國聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 十二名政策制定者中三人投反對票，市場觀望 FED 主席沃什如何解決內部分歧，而且美國軍方稱已打擊伊朗革命衛隊數十個目標，戰火恐蔓延至中東更多國家，週四推動美元回升；此外，中東緊張局勢導致油價上漲，壓縮日本家庭支出和企業利潤，對高度依賴燃料進口的經濟造成壓力，政府下調 2026 財政年實質國內生產總值 (GDP) 增長預測至 0.9%，而且日本執政黨自民黨高級官員稱，首相高市早苗有意推進大幅下調 8% 的食品消費稅稅率至 1% 為期兩年，可能進一步加重不斷惡化的財政負擔，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓觸及 163.73 高點。

paras: 美元周四 (30 日) 下跌，交易員對聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 強調抗通膨立場持懷疑態度。同時，日元大幅升值，創下 2022 年以來最大單日漲幅。分析認為，這波走勢看起來像是日本政府正式介入外匯市場。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 1%，報 99.89，寫下 4 月 21 日以來最差單日表現。
截至發稿，尚未確認日本當局是否進場交易，但日元如此大幅波動，加上銀行回報外匯交易量明顯高於平常，都顯示可能存在官方干預。
美元兌日元一度下跌 3%，至 158.34 日元，低於本周稍早創下的近 164 日元、40 年高點。
日本央行 (BoJ) 將於周五公布最新利率決策。周三美國聯準會維持利率不變，但美元受到打擊，因交易員開始質疑聯準會新任主席是否真的會積極遏制通膨。
三菱 UFJ 摩根士丹利證券外匯策略師 Daisaku Ueno 表示，「很難想像，除了外匯干預外，還有什麼因素能讓日元在如此短的時間內升值 5 日元。」
「如果這確實是一次干預，許多市場參與者原本預期干預會發生在 FOMC 與日本央行會議之後，因此當局可能有意讓市場措手不及。」
外匯交易量也同步大幅增加。花旗銷售與交易部門在給機構客戶的報告中指出，美東時間上午 9:30 至 9:40 期間，其電子交易平台估計在主要外匯交易市場有約 81 億美元的美元兌日元賣單。

日元兌歐元與英鎊同步升值逾 2%，兌澳幣則升值近 2%。
債市未完全信服華許立場
投資人持續消化聯準會周三決定維持利率不變的影響，目前市場焦點更多放在華許會後記者會上的談話。
雖然聯準會維持利率不變大致符合市場預期，但由於油價劇烈波動引發通膨環境快速變化，市場對升息的預期高於近期歷史水準。
華許在會後記者會上表示，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 內部經歷了一場「良好的家庭辯論」，進行了「積極且充分的討論」，主要圍繞四個議題：持續存在的通膨問題、近期經濟衝擊及由這些衝擊帶來的價格壓力，以及貨幣政策工具。
華許也表示，三位地方聯準銀行總裁的反對票「並未完全反映整場討論的本質」，而 6 月通膨數據走弱對此次利率決策影響「並不大」。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Thursday (the 30th) as traders expressed skepticism toward Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's emphasis on an anti‑inflation stance. At the same time, the yen rallied sharply, posting its biggest one‑day gain since 2022. Analysts said the move looks like a formal intervention by the Japanese government in the foreign‑exchange market.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, dropped 1% to 99.89, marking its worst single‑day performance since April 21.

At the time of writing, it has not been confirmed whether Japanese authorities entered the market, but the yen’s extreme volatility, combined with bank‑reported FX trading volumes clearly above normal, suggests possible official intervention.
The dollar‑yen pair fell as much as 3% to ¥158.34, below the near‑¥164 level—a 40‑year high—set earlier this week.

The Bank of Japan will announce its latest rate decision on Friday. The Fed kept rates unchanged on Wednesday, but the dollar was hit as traders began to doubt whether the new Fed chair would aggressively curb inflation.
Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley FX strategist Daisaku Ueno said, "It's hard to imagine any factor other than FX intervention that could push the yen up by five yen in such a short time."
"If this is indeed an intervention, many market participants had expected it to occur after the FOMC and BoJ meetings, so the authorities may have deliberately caught the market off‑guard," he added.

FX trading volume also surged. Citi’s sales and trading division noted in a report to institutional clients that between 9:30 a.m. and 9:40 a.m. ET, its electronic platform estimated about $8.1 billion of dollar‑yen sell orders in the major FX market.
Citi said, "Intervention looks like a plausible explanation."
The yen also appreciated over 2% against the euro and the pound, and rose nearly 2% against the Australian dollar.
Bond market not fully convinced by Warsh’s stance
Investors continue to digest the impact of the Fed’s Wednesday decision to keep rates steady, with market focus now shifting to Warsh’s remarks at the post‑meeting press conference.

Although the Fed’s hold was broadly in line with expectations, the rapid swing in oil prices has sparked a quickly changing inflation environment, leaving rate‑hike expectations above recent historical levels.

Warsh said after the press conference that the Federal Open Market Committee had a "good family debate" with "vigorous and thorough discussion," focusing on four topics: persistent inflation, recent economic shocks and the price pressures they generate, and monetary‑policy tools.

He also noted that the three regional Fed bank presidents’ dissenting votes "did not fully reflect the nature of the discussion," and that the weaker June inflation data had "little impact" on the rate decision.

Macquarie FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman observed, "We gleaned several observations from the press conference. One is that Warsh is deliberately postponing a Fed policy‑rate hike, using rhetoric instead of action, while trying to mask or shift his fundamentally dovish stance."
After the Fed decision and Warsh’s remarks were released, U.S. Treasury yields diverged on Wednesday: long‑term yields rose, while shorter‑term, policy‑sensitive yields fell.
That trend continued on Thursday. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose more than 4 basis points to 4.666%, while the 2‑year yield slipped slightly to 4.234%.

paras: 日元周四 (30 日) 兌美元突然暴升逾 3%，創 2023 年 12 月以來最大單日漲幅，引發市場猜測日本政府可能再度進場干預匯市，以阻止日元持續貶值。不過，日本官方目前尚未證實採取任何行動。
日元稍早一度跌至 1 美元兌 164 日元附近，創近 40 年新低，隨後突然急升，紐約盤中最高來到 157.98 日元，單日升幅一度達 3.3%。紐約梅隆銀行 (BNY) 資深策略師 Geoffrey Yu 表示，這波升值規模強烈暗示官方可能進場干預，但干預措施能否產生持久效果仍有疑問。
日本財務省官員暫未回應，白宮也未針對相關消息發表評論。本月稍早，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳接受《彭博》訪問時，並未重申財務省慣用的外匯政策說法，包括隨時準備採取「大膽行動」，當時便引發市場揣測。
日元近來持續受到油價上漲、日本財政疑慮及美日利差過大的壓力。即使日本官方上一季才實施創紀錄的干預，日元仍在 6 月跌至 1986 年以來最低水準，並於 7 月進一步走弱。
日本政府在 4 月 28 日至 5 月 27 日期間，據信投入創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元 (約 732 億美元) 支撐日元。日本財務省外匯存底數據顯示，當局可能出售包括美國公債在內的外國證券，為干預行動提供資金。
日本過去的干預效果大多有限。當局在 2022 年首度採取 1998 年以來的日元買進行動，2024 年也投入約 1,000 億美元，但通常只能暫時扭轉跌勢，日元之後仍重回貶值軌道。
這波急升發生在日銀 (日本央行 / BOJ) 周五 (31 日) 公布利率決策前夕。市場預期，日銀繼上月升息、把基準利率推升至 1995 年以來最高水準後，本次將維持利率不變。
聯準會 (Fed) 本周同樣按兵不動，但市場仍預期美國今年稍晚可能升息，使美日利差持續不利日元。不過，Fed 決策公布後美元一度走低，讓日本政府若確實進場干預，得以順著市場方向推動日元升值。分析人士認為，選在美國利率決策後及日本市場收盤後出手，也符合日本財務省過去的操作方式。
paras_en: On Thursday (the 30th), the yen suddenly jumped more than 3% against the dollar, marking the biggest single‑day gain since December 2023 and sparking market speculation that the Japanese government may have intervened again to halt the yen’s continued depreciation. However, Japanese officials have not confirmed any action.

The yen had earlier slipped to around ¥164 per $1, a near‑40‑year low, before abruptly rallying to a high of ¥157.98 in the New York session, a one‑day rise of up to 3.3%. Senior strategist Geoffrey Yu of BNY Mellon said the size of the move strongly hints at official intervention, though it remains uncertain whether such measures will have lasting impact.

The Ministry of Finance has not responded, and the White House has not commented on the reports. Earlier this month, Japan’s top foreign‑exchange official, Jun Mimura, told Bloomberg that he would not repeat the ministry’s usual policy language about being ready to take “bold action,” which had previously fueled market speculation.

The yen has recently been under pressure from rising oil prices, concerns over Japan’s fiscal health and a wide U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. Even after a record‑size intervention last quarter, the yen fell to its lowest level since 1986 in June and weakened further in July.

Between April 28 and May 27, the Japanese government is believed to have deployed a record ¥11.73 trillion (about $73.2 billion) to support the yen. Data on the ministry’s foreign‑exchange reserves suggest the authorities may have sold foreign securities, including U.S. Treasuries, to fund the intervention.

Historically, Japan’s interventions have yielded limited results. The authorities first bought yen in 2022—the first such action since 1998—and again spent roughly $100 billion in 2024, but these moves typically only provided a temporary pause before the yen resumed its decline.

The sharp rally came on the eve of the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) rate decision on Friday (the 31st). Markets expect the BOJ, after raising rates last month to the highest level since 1995, to keep policy unchanged this time.

The U.S. Federal Reserve also held rates steady this week, but markets still anticipate a possible rate hike later in the year, which would keep the U.S.–Japan rate gap unfavorable for the yen. After the Fed’s announcement, the dollar briefly fell, giving the Japanese government—if it does intervene—a chance to push the yen higher in line with market direction. Analysts note that intervening after the U.S. rate decision and after the Japanese market close aligns with the Ministry of Finance’s typical operating pattern.

items.title_en: Bank of England Holds Rate Steady Amid Rising Hawkish Voices; Three Officials Call for a Hike but Market Unconvinced
paras: 英國央行 (BoE) 周四 (30 日) 宣布維持基準利率在 3.75% 不變，符合市場預期，但貨幣政策委員會 (MPC) 以 6 比 3 通過利率決策，支持升息的官員較上次會議增加 1 人，鷹派陣營擴大幅度超乎預期，反映美伊衝突升溫及能源價格劇烈波動，正加深英國通膨前景的不確定性。
根據會議紀錄，首席經濟學家皮爾 (Huw Pill)、外部委員格林(Megan Greene) 與曼恩 (Catherine Mann) 主張升息 1 碼 (25 個基點) 至 4%，其中曼恩是本次新加入升息陣營的官員。多數接受《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預期，表決結果將維持上次會議的 7 比 2。
英國央行維持「隨時準備採取行動」的政策指引，以防高通膨持續過久。不過，多數官員認為，國內通膨壓力已有明顯緩解跡象，目前也幾乎沒有證據顯示能源衝擊已擴散至薪資要求及其他商品價格，因此現階段仍適合按兵不動。

美伊戰火推升通膨風險

英國央行總裁貝里 (Andrew Bailey) 表示，全球情勢變得更加不確定且更具通膨壓力，但英國國內環境對通膨前景而言相對溫和，因此維持利率不變是適當決定。他也坦言，目前尚未出現明顯的第二輪通膨效應，但現在就因此感到安心仍為時過早。
曼恩指出，美伊初步停火安排破裂，加上衝突在本月擴大，是她轉而支持升息的主要原因。支持升息的官員認為，英國通膨在過去近 5 年大部分時間都高於央行 2% 目標，增加能源成本向薪資及其他價格擴散的風險。
英國央行恢復發布單一基準通膨預測，並另外提出溫和與不利情境。基準預測顯示，英國通膨率將從 6 月的 2.6% 升至今年底的 3.2%，隨後逐步回落。在油價突破每桶 100 美元並維持高檔、天然氣價格上漲 60% 的不利情境下，通膨率可能在 2027 年第 2 季攀抵 4.5%；若中東衝突較快落幕，通膨高點則約為 3%。

國內壓力降溫支撐觀望

儘管能源價格構成威脅，疲弱的經濟、趨緩的薪資成長及金融環境收緊，仍讓英國央行擁有更多觀察時間。英國職缺與民間部門薪資增幅目前均降至疫情以來最低水準，有助降低能源衝擊轉化為持續性通膨的可能性。
副總裁拉姆斯登 (Dave Ramsden) 及外部委員泰勒 (Alan Taylor) 更表示，若美伊戰事迅速結束、通膨降溫趨勢延續，不排除重新考慮降息；其他支持維持利率不變的官員則較接近升息立場，顯示委員會內部對下一步政策方向仍存在明顯分歧。
利率決策公布後，交易員削減英國央行升息押注，對政策敏感的 2 年期英國公債殖利率下跌 8 個基點至 4.37%，市場目前預期年底前累計升息約 35 個基點。
英國央行也在 9 月決定新一年度量化緊縮 (QT) 步調前指出，縮減資產負債表自 2022 年以來，約為 10 年期英國公債殖利率增加 20 至 30 個基點，影響程度雖屬溫和，但略高於去年的估計。市場普遍預期，央行可能把每年減持公債規模由 700 億英鎊進一步降至 500 億英鎊。
paras_en: The Bank of England (BoE) announced on Thursday (the 30th) that it will keep the Bank Rate at 3.75%, in line with market expectations. The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) voted 6‑3 on the decision, with one more member supporting a rate hike than at the previous meeting, expanding the hawkish camp more than anticipated. The shift reflects heightened uncertainty over the UK inflation outlook as the Israel‑Iran conflict intensifies and energy prices swing sharply.

According to the meeting minutes, chief economist Huw Pill, external member Megan Greene and Catherine Mann advocated raising the rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 4%. Mann is the newcomer to the hawkish side this time. Most economists surveyed by Reuters had originally expected a 7‑2 vote to keep the rate unchanged.

The BoE maintained its “ready to act” policy guidance to guard against prolonged high inflation. However, most members said domestic inflation pressure has shown clear signs of easing and there is little evidence that the energy shock is feeding into wage demands or other price items, so staying on hold is still appropriate at this stage.

BoE Governor Andrew Bailey said global conditions have become more uncertain and inflation‑pressured, but the domestic environment is relatively moderate for the inflation outlook, making a rate‑hold the right call. He admitted that a clear second‑round inflation effect has not yet emerged, but it would be premature to feel comfortable because of that.

Mann explained that the breakdown of an initial Israel‑Iran cease‑fire and the escalation of fighting this month were the main reasons she switched to supporting a hike. Hawkish members argue that UK inflation has been above the 2% target for most of the past five years, raising the risk that higher energy costs could spill over into wages and other prices.

The BoE resumed publishing a single baseline inflation forecast, alongside mild and adverse scenarios. The baseline projects UK inflation rising from 2.6% in June to 3.2% by year‑end, then gradually falling. In an adverse case where oil prices stay above $100 a barrel and gas prices jump 60%, inflation could reach 4.5% in Q2 2027; if the Middle‑East conflict eases quickly, the peak would be around 3%.

Even though energy prices pose a threat, a weak economy, slowing wage growth and tighter financial conditions give the BoE more time to observe. Job vacancies and private‑sector wage growth have fallen to their lowest levels since the pandemic, helping to reduce the chance that the energy shock turns into persistent inflation.

Deputy Governor Dave Ramsden and external member Alan Taylor said that if the Israel‑Iran war ends swiftly and the inflation‑cooling trend continues, a rate cut could be reconsidered. Other members who favoured keeping rates steady are closer to the hawkish side, showing a clear split within the committee over the next policy step.

After the rate decision, traders trimmed bets on a BoE hike, pushing the policy‑sensitive two‑year gilt yield down 8 basis points to 4.37%. The market now expects roughly 35 basis points of cumulative hikes by year‑end.

The BoE also noted ahead of its September decision on the pace of quantitative tightening (QT) that balance‑sheet reduction since 2022 has added about 20‑30 basis points to ten‑year gilt yields. The impact is modest but slightly higher than last year’s estimate. Markets broadly anticipate the BoE may cut its annual gilt‑buy‑back programme from £70 billion to £50 billion.

items.title: 〈台幣〉Fed內部分歧！盤中又見貶破32.5 央行出手阻貶收32.454元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Falls Below 32.5 as Fed Shows Internal Split; Central Bank Steps In to Halt Decline, Closing at 32.454
paras: 美國聯準會 (Fed) 宣布利率連五凍，但有三位委員投下反對票，主張應升息，「鷹派聲浪」逐漸增強。受到外資匯出影響，新台幣兌美元今 (30) 日再度貶破 32.5 元關卡，尾盤仍靠央行進場穩匯，帶動匯價貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.454 元、貶值 8.8 分，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值放大至 31.93 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 32.38 元，隨著外資擴大匯出，盤中一度貶至 32.518 元，央行持續出手穩定匯價，帶動貶幅收斂，終場收在 32.454 元、貶值 8.8 分，呈現股匯雙殺格局。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，美元指數下跌 0.29%，新台幣貶值 0.27%，日圓小跌 0.03%，韓元持續升值 0.67%，人民幣升值 0.12%，星幣小升 0.02%，亞幣走勢不同調。
台股連日重挫，今日開盤後上演千點大反彈，台積電、聯發科等權值股奮力撐盤，但多空陷入激戰，追價意願不高，終場翻黑下跌 105.88 點，收在 39933.30 點，失守 4 萬點大關。
Fed 本次決議維持利率於 3.5% 至 3.75% 不變，但有多達 3 名地區聯準銀行總裁投下反對票並主張升息 1 碼。雖然主席華許認為市場利率自然上升已達緊縮效果，因而選擇觀望，但鷹派官員擔憂在關稅、伊戰推升能源價格以及 AI 基礎建設熱潮等需求壓力下，長期居高不下的通膨已非單純的「短期現象」，內部對於是否需要進一步收緊政策存在顯著分歧。
隨著通膨再度面臨上行風險，外界認為聯準會今年稍晚重啟升息的門檻已明顯降低，市場對升息的疑慮隨即引發震盪，造成美股道瓊狂瀉逾 1,100 點、30 年期美債殖利率創下 2007 年以來新高。
目前聯準會內部正密切觀察經濟是否過熱，9 月政策會議前公布的兩份通膨報告將成為是否啟動升息的關鍵依據；此外，若聯準會最終選擇在秋季期中選舉前升息，亦可能重新引爆與川普政府之間的政治衝突。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced a fifth consecutive rate hold, but three members voted against it, urging a rate hike as hawkish sentiment grows. Influenced by foreign capital outflows, the New Taiwan dollar slipped past the 32.5 per U.S. dollar mark again on the 30th, but the central bank’s intervention near the close steadied the market, narrowing the depreciation and ending at 32.454, down 8.8 cents, with total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets expanding to $3.193 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.38 per dollar today. As foreign investors expanded outflows, it briefly fell to 32.518 during the session. The central bank kept intervening to stabilize the rate, narrowing the loss and closing at 32.454, down 8.8 cents, creating a double‑whammy of falling stocks and currency.

Looking at major currencies, the central bank’s data show the U.S. dollar index fell 0.29%, the New Taiwan dollar weakened 0.27%, the yen slipped 0.03%, the Korean won rose 0.67%, the Chinese yuan appreciated 0.12%, the Singapore dollar edged up 0.02%, while other Asian currencies moved in mixed directions.

Taiwan’s stock market has been battered for days. After a sharp rebound of several thousand points following the open, heavyweight stocks such as TSMC and MediaTek tried to support the market, but buying pressure remained weak. The index closed lower, down 105.88 points to 39,933.30, slipping below the 40,000‑point threshold.

The Fed’s decision kept the policy rate unchanged at 3.5%‑3.75%, yet up to three regional Fed bank presidents voted against the hold and called for a one‑point hike. Chair Jerome Powell said market rates have risen enough to achieve tightening, so he opted to wait. Hawkish officials, however, warned that tariffs, the war in Ukraine driving up energy prices, and the AI infrastructure boom are keeping inflation persistently high, not just a short‑term issue, revealing a sharp internal split over further tightening.

With inflation again posing upside risks, analysts think the threshold for a later‑year rate hike has clearly lowered, sparking market volatility. The Dow Jones plunged more than 1,100 points and the 30‑year U.S. Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007.

The Fed is closely monitoring whether the economy is overheating ahead of the September policy meeting. Two inflation reports to be released before that meeting will be pivotal in deciding whether to restart hikes. Moreover, if the Fed decides to raise rates before the mid‑term elections in the fall, it could reignite political friction with the Trump administration.
